# Smooth Moves

> Jacksonville Beach, Florida moving company. Moving Made Simple.

Smooth Moves (Smooth Moves, Inc.) is a locally owned moving company based at 907 6th Avenue South, Jacksonville Beach, FL 32250. The company provides local and long-distance moving, commercial and corporate relocation, military moving, senior moving, and packing services. The same crew loads and unloads, and long-distance moves use direct delivery — belongings stay on one dedicated truck with no shared loads or transfers, anywhere in the continental United States.

Owner Joe McConville and co-owner Heather McConville were born and raised in Jacksonville. The company was founded in 2003 and began as a delivery partner for local cabinetry and millwork companies before becoming a full-service mover. Contact: (904) 626-1206 and joe@smoothmovesfl.com. Website: https://smoothmovesfl.com/

## Services

- Local moving in Jacksonville and Northeast Florida, with hourly rates, lift-gate trucks, and packing available
- Long-distance moving throughout the continental United States with direct delivery, a dedicated truck and crew, and guaranteed upfront pricing
- Commercial moving: offices, warehouses, retail, FF&E, with flexible scheduling and lift gates for pallets and heavy equipment
- Corporate relocation with in-home or virtual estimates
- Senior moving with on-site consultation, decluttering and organization help, and a 10% discount on local moves
- Military moving, including families at NAS Jacksonville and Mayport Naval Station, with a 10% discount for active and retired military on moving and packing
- Packing, unpacking, and moving supplies

## Service area

Local service area (from the company’s Facebook page): Nocatee, Atlantic Beach, Jacksonville Beach, Green Cove Springs, St. Augustine, Ponte Vedra, Ponte Vedra Beach, Neptune Beach, Middleburg, and Jacksonville. Long-distance moving is available throughout the continental United States.

## Discounts

10% off the hourly rate for military, first responders, senior citizens, and realtor-referred clients. The company also offers a 10% discount on packing services for active and retired military, and a 10% senior discount on local moves.

## Reviews

Smooth Moves is rated 4.9 out of 5 from 600 Google reviews and is recommended by 94% of reviewers on Facebook (13 reviews). The company states it is licensed and insured.
